summary.text: Dawn Gile is a Democratic Maryland state senator from District 33 in Anne Arundel County who has held the seat since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, she serves on the Senate Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Dawn Gile was born in Dubuque, Iowa, and graduated from Stillman Valley High School in Illinois in 1998.
She earned a B.A. in psychology and French from Rockford University in 2002 and a J.D. from Loyola University Chicago School of Law in 2006.
Gile is admitted to the Maryland, Illinois and District of Columbia bars and was an associate and then partner at MacDonald Law Group, a partner from 2018 to 2024.
She has also been of counsel to SRD Legal Group since 2023.
Gile assumed office in the Maryland State Senate on January 11, 2023, succeeding Edward R. Reilly.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.
